what_it_is: One-count 18 U.S.C. § 1542 false statement in a passport application against Abdiaziz Shafii Farah only. NOT the Feeding Our Future / Empire Kitchen fraud indictment.

counts.title: False statement in a passport application
counts.allegation: On or about 2022-03-22, defendant submitted a passport application stating his previous passport had been lost when, as alleged, he had not lost it.

gaps: FOF/Empire fraud charging instrument on this docket is still missing (likely a later superseding indictment, not ECF 22).
